tools.name: launch_boosted_post_campaign
tools.description: Creates a paid boost for a published social post by charging the ad account budget through the ad platform, notifies the campaign owner by email, and triggers the audience-sync job for the campaign.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the published post to boost

params.name: duration_days
params.description: Number of days to run the boost

params.name: audience_segment
params.description: Name of the target audience segment

params.name: owner_email
params.description: Email of the person to notify

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("social-ads")

ADS_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("ADS_API_BASE_URL", "https://ads.example.com/v1")
ADS_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get("ADS_API_TOKEN", "")
ADS_ACCOUNT_ID = os.environ.get("ADS_ACCOUNT_ID", "")
SMTP_HOST_NAME = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")


@mcp.tool()
def launch_boosted_post_campaign(
    post_id: str,
    daily_budget_cents: int,
    duration_days: int,
    audience_segment: str,
    owner_email: str,
) -> dict:
    total_budget_in_cents = daily_budget_cents * duration_days
    request_headers_for_ads_api = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {ADS_API_TOKEN}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    boost_request_payload = {
        "account_id": ADS_ACCOUNT_ID,
        "post_id": post_id,
        "daily_budget_cents": daily_budget_cents,
        "duration_days": duration_days,
        "audience": audience_segment,
        "charge_total_cents": total_budget_in_cents,
    }
    boost_api_response = requests.post(
        f"{ADS_API_BASE_URL}/boosts",
        json=boost_request_payload,
        headers=request_headers_for_ads_api,
        timeout=30,
    )
    boost_api_response.raise_for_status()
    created_boost_record = boost_api_response.json()
    created_boost_identifier = created_boost_record["id"]

    notification_email_message = EmailMessage()
    notification_email_message["Subject"] = f"Boost {created_boost_identifier} launched for post {post_id}"
    notification_email_message["From"] = "ads-bot@example.com"
    notification_email_message["To"] = owner_email
    notification_email_message.set_content(
        f"Your boost for post {post_id} is live.\n"
        f"Audience: {audience_segment}\n"
        f"Total budget: ${total_budget_in_cents / 100:.2f} over {duration_days} days."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST_NAME) as smtp_connection_to_server:
        smtp_connection_to_server.send_message(notification_email_message)

    audience_sync_completed_process = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/sync_audience.py", "--boost-id", created_boost_identifier],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )

    return {
        "boost_id": created_boost_identifier,
        "total_charged_cents": total_budget_in_cents,
        "sync_exit_code": audience_sync_completed_process.returncode,
    }

tools.name: promote_member_to_channel_admin
tools.description: Grants a team member admin rights on a social channel and records the change in the roster. Also applies the channel's admin seat fee to the workspace billing balance.

params.name: member_id
params.description: ID of the team member to promote

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("social-team")

ADMIN_SEAT_FEE_CENTS = 1500


@dataclass
class PromotionResult:
    channel_id: str
    member_id: str
    new_role: str
    fee_charged_cents: int


@mcp.tool()
def promote_member_to_channel_admin(channel_id: str, member_id: str) -> PromotionResult:
    connection = sqlite3.connect("social.db")
    with connection:
        connection.execute(
            "UPDATE channel_members SET role = 'admin' WHERE channel_id = ? AND member_id = ?",
            (channel_id, member_id),
        )
        connection.execute(
            "UPDATE billing SET balance_cents = balance_cents - ? WHERE id = 1",
            (ADMIN_SEAT_FEE_CENTS,),
        )
    connection.close()
    return PromotionResult(channel_id, member_id, "admin", ADMIN_SEAT_FEE_CENTS)

tools.name: move_post_to_published_archive
tools.description: Moves a post's media folder from the drafts area to the published archive and sends the new archive location to the team's notification webhook.

params.name: post_slug
params.description: Slug of the post whose media folder should be moved

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL to notify with the new location

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from agents import function_tool

DRAFTS_ROOT = Path("media/drafts")
ARCHIVE_ROOT = Path("media/published")


@function_tool
def move_post_to_published_archive(post_slug: str, webhook_url: str) -> str:
    if not post_slug or "/" in post_slug or "\\" in post_slug or ".." in post_slug:
        return "Error: invalid post slug"
    if not webhook_url.startswith("https://"):
        return "Error: webhook_url must be https"
    source_folder = DRAFTS_ROOT / post_slug
    if not source_folder.is_dir():
        return f"Error: no draft folder for {post_slug}"
    target_folder = ARCHIVE_ROOT / post_slug
    if target_folder.exists():
        return "Error: archive folder already exists"
    ARCHIVE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_folder), str(target_folder))
    requests.post(webhook_url, json={"post": post_slug, "location": str(target_folder)}, timeout=15)
    return f"Moved to {target_folder}"

tools.name: run_paid_influencer_payout_job
tools.description: Runs the payout script for an influencer's completed campaign, which pays the influencer the agreed amount. Rejects the request if the amount or handle is invalid.
tools.code:
import re
import subprocess

from agents import function_tool

MAX_PAYOUT_USD = 5000.0


@function_tool
def run_paid_influencer_payout_job(influencer_handle: str, campaign_id: str, amount_usd: float) -> str:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"@[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,30}", influencer_handle or ""):
        return "Error: invalid influencer handle"
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}", campaign_id or ""):
        return "Error: invalid campaign id"
    if amount_usd <= 0:
        return "Error: amount must be positive"
    if amount_usd > MAX_PAYOUT_USD:
        return f"Error: amount exceeds limit of {MAX_PAYOUT_USD}"
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [
            "python",
            "jobs/pay_influencer.py",
            "--handle",
            influencer_handle,
            "--campaign",
            campaign_id,
            "--amount",
            f"{amount_usd:.2f}",
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return f"Payout failed: {completed.stderr.strip()}"
    return completed.stdout.strip() or "Payout complete"
